subject: reasoning
question: If ‘P’ stands for ‘×’, ‘Q’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘R’ stands for ‘−’ and ‘S’ stands for ‘+’, then the resultant of which of the following would be 57?
solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/c0j5U9v2oJWEzSTKvdDLWZ5Zik3PBUXk-C9w3Ma990WH63rpQUfA7g-3wh_uT7CgFvFJ4jPGEeOw509FxSgfh78_HR9tDNZ9KitXdEveKsLaLMgPQf6YSDt1b775728JMVp9FIQs=s0] 

According to the question, the letters are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Letter
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 
 

 New Symbol
 ×
 ÷
 −
 +
 
 

 

**1) (160 Q 10) R (30 P 2) R (16 Q 4) S 45**

⇒ (160 ÷ 10) − (30 × 2) − (16 ÷ 4) + 45

⇒ 16 − 60 − 4 + 45

⇒ −44 − 4 + 45

⇒ −48 + 45 = −3 (Incorrect)

**2) (160 Q 10) R (30 Q 2) S (16 P 4) R 45**

⇒ (160 ÷ 10) − (30 ÷ 2) + (16 × 4) − 45

⇒ 16 − 15 + 64 − 45

⇒ 1 + 64 − 45

⇒ 65 − 45 = 20 (Incorrect)

**3) (160 Q 10) S (30 P 2) R (16 P 4) S 45**

⇒ (160 ÷ 10) + (30 × 2) − (16 × 4) + 45

⇒ 16 + 60 − 64 + 45

⇒ __**76 − 64**__ + 45

⇒ __**12 + 45**__

⇒ 57 (Correct)

**4) (160 R 10) S (30 Q 2) S (16 Q 4) R 45**

⇒ (160 − 10) + (30 ÷ 2) + (16 ÷ 4) − 45

⇒ 150 + 15 + 4 − 45

⇒ 169 − 45 = 124 (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
